name: Numbers
summary: Five numbers sections for the AhaSlides marketing sites (Webflow Numbers), in the layouts of the Untitled UI metrics sections the marketing team picked: simple with actions in a row and with icons, centred text with dividers, and a split with an image slot, also on the brand band. Framework-free HTML and CSS bound to the shared --aha-* tokens, built from values the Hero, Cards, Hero banner and Features sections already ship.
highlights: Five layouts on one page, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet
Layout copied from Untitled UI; every colour, size, space, radius and font is an --aha-* token, and the eyebrow, title, lead and buttons carry the Hero section's values verbatim
A number looks the same here as in the Statistic card on the Cards page: same display font, size, weight and colour, with the same title and text beneath
The brand band is the Hero banner's solid pink with its white text, no new colour
The picture is an image slot (4:3, the Cards and Hero banner ratio) with a neutral placeholder to swap for a real image; nothing is recreated in HTML
Icons are registry glyphs called by name with <aha-icon>
Each section is a container-query block: it steps down at 991 px and 767 px and tightens again below 480 px, wherever it sits
